name: pulser audio
changelog:
• Offline Downloaded Tracks Playback: Fixed offline playback for downloaded songs in All Tracks using native file fetch and IndexedDB blob backup
• Ultra-Low CPU & GPU Footprint: Removed heavy convolution blur shaders and constant animations (<0.5% idle load)
• Resilient & Fast Auto-Updater: Added HTTP Range resume (.part) with 10-retry auto-reconnect on network drops
• Fixed Update UI Percentage: Fixed progress bar percentage sync bug
• Windows Update Installation Fixed: Resolved Windows installer spawn error
